target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: Android chat controls added a visible new-chat path and slash picker, but the first PR shape routed local `/new` or `/reset` handling through admin-scoped `sessions.reset` and duplicated the Gateway command catalog with Android fallback defaults.
- Solution: Keep Gateway `commands.list` as the only command source, remove local exact slash-command interception for `/new` and `/reset`, and move the Android header new-chat control to the write-scoped `sessions.create` path.
- What changed: Android now relies on Gateway command metadata for slash suggestions and uses session creation for the header New Chat path.
  - Android command state now starts empty and is populated only from Gateway command metadata.
  - Failed or empty command discovery no longer falls back to a hard-coded Android catalog.
  - Slash-command selection completes command text in the composer instead of invoking local reset behavior.
  - Header New Chat creates a new session through `sessions.create` and reloads session/history state.
  - Native i18n inventory was resynced after Android source changes.
  - Focused Android tests were updated for command filtering and the new-chat session creation path.
- What did NOT change (scope boundary): Gateway execution policy and project infrastructure stay unchanged.
  - No Gateway command descriptors, provider routing, model behavior, permissions grants, dependencies, workflows, or lockfiles were changed.
  - No connected Android visual proof is claimed in this body.

## Motivation

Android users need discoverable chat controls without Android becoming a second command policy layer. The UI should expose the Gateway-advertised commands and start a fresh chat through a scope-correct session path, while leaving command execution and availability decisions at the Gateway boundary.

## Change Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [x] API / contracts
- [x] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- Related: reviewer feedback on this PR
- [x] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior or issue addressed: Android chat command controls no longer use the admin-scoped `sessions.reset` path for new chat, and Android no longer advertises hard-coded fallback slash commands when Gateway command discovery is unavailable.
- Real environment tested (affected runtime/layer, not just "unit test"): Android app JVM test runtime for the affected chat controller and Compose command-filter logic, plus the native i18n inventory check for the Android source tree.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```bash
git diff --check
pnpm native:i18n:check
cd apps/android
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest
grep -R "defaultChatCommands\|isNewChatSlashCommand\|sessions.reset" -n apps/android/app/src/main/java apps/android/app/src/test/java || true
```

- Evidence after fix:

```text
git diff --check
PASS

pnpm native:i18n:check
native-app-i18n: entries=2360 changed=false
PASS

Focused Android tests
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 50s
60 actionable tasks: 60 up-to-date

Stale Android source/test reference check
No matches for defaultChatCommands, isNewChatSlashCommand, or sessions.reset.
```

- Public artifact URLs, if screenshots/videos/files are referenced:

```text
None.
```

- Observed result after fix: The Android command catalog is Gateway-only, `/` suggestions still filter by command name or alias, exact `/new` and `/reset` are no longer intercepted locally, and the New Chat header path sends `sessions.create` before refreshing session/history state.
- What was not tested: A connected Android emulator/device session with screenshots or a recording of the chat header, slash picker, and fresh-chat flow was not completed in this phase.
- Before evidence:

```text
The pre-P1 PR shape contained an Android fallback command catalog and routed the new-chat/reset UI path through sessions.reset. The current patch removes those Android references and updates tests for the sessions.create path.
```

- Visual proof:
  - Before screenshot/video: None.
  - After screenshot/video: None.
  - If not applicable, why: Visual proof is applicable, but it was not completed in this phase.
- Remaining proof gap: Connected Android visual verification is still missing; this body only claims command, i18n, and focused Android unit-test proof.

## Root Cause

- Root cause: Android introduced its own command defaults and local exact command handling instead of treating Gateway command metadata and chat/session APIs as the source of truth.
- Missing detection / guardrail: Existing tests did not prevent Android from showing commands not advertised by Gateway, and did not assert that New Chat used a non-admin session creation path.
- Contributing context (if known): Android needed a visible chat control surface, but the first implementation mixed UI affordances with command/session policy.

## Regression Test Plan

- Coverage level that should have caught this:
  - [x] Unit test
  - [ ] Seam / integration test
  - [ ] End-to-end test
  - [ ] Existing coverage already sufficient
- Target test or file:
  - `apps/android/app/src/test/java/ai/openclaw/app/chat/ChatControllerCommandControlsTest.kt`
  - `apps/android/app/src/test/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/chat/ChatCommandControlsTest.kt`
- Scenario the test should lock in:
  - Android New Chat sends `sessions.create` with the current parent session key.
  - Slash suggestions match command names and aliases only.
  - Exact `/new` and `/reset` selection does not bypass the normal composer/chat command path.
- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: These tests lock the Android contract at the controller and command-filter boundaries without needing a live Gateway for every unit test run; the fallback-catalog removal is additionally verified by source/symbol scan in this proof.
- Existing test that already covers this (if any): Existing slash-filter tests covered prefix behavior; this patch updates the suite to cover the new-chat `sessions.create` path and removes the obsolete exact `/new` or `/reset` local-handler test.
- If no new test is added, why not: Tests were updated for the session path and command filtering. No separate fallback-catalog unit test was added because the fallback factory was removed outright and the proof includes a stale-symbol source check.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Android users still see a New Chat control and slash-command suggestions. The visible command list now reflects only Gateway-advertised commands, and exact slash text such as `/new` or `/reset` is no longer swallowed by a local Android reset handler.

## Diagram

```text
Header New Chat
  -> ChatController.startNewChatAwait()
  -> Gateway sessions.create
  -> update session key
  -> reload session/history state

Composer "/..."
  -> Gateway commands.list result
  -> Android name/alias prefix filter
  -> selected command text stays in composer
  -> normal chat send path handles execution
```

## Security Impact

- New permissions/capabilities? No.
- Secrets/tokens handling changed? No.
- New/changed network calls? Yes. Android New Chat now calls `sessions.create` instead of the previous admin-scoped `sessions.reset` path.
- Command/tool execution surface changed? Yes. Android no longer executes exact `/new` or `/reset` locally; selected slash commands stay on the normal chat command path.
- Data access scope changed? No broader access. The patch removes the admin-scoped new-chat path from Android and keeps command availability tied to Gateway discovery.
- If any `Yes`, explain risk + mitigation: The changed session call is narrower than the prior reset path and is covered by focused Android controller tests. The command surface change reduces local Android policy by removing fallback command defaults and exact command interception.

## Repro + Verification

### Environment

- OS: Local OpenClawUbuntu PR lane
- Runtime/container: Android Gradle/JVM unit-test runtime
- Model/provider: Not involved
- Integration/channel (if any): Android app chat controller and Compose command controls
- Relevant config (redacted): Android SDK/JDK/Gradle tooling configured; no secrets or private service endpoints used

### Steps

1. Run source whitespace validation with `git diff --check`.
2. Run native i18n inventory validation with `pnpm native:i18n:check`.
3. Run focused Android command-control tests for chat controller and UI command filtering.
4. Search Android source/tests for stale fallback or reset symbols.

### Expected

- Native i18n inventory has no drift.
- Focused Android tests pass.
- Android source/tests no longer reference `defaultChatCommands`, `isNewChatSlashCommand`, or `sessions.reset`.

### Actual

- Native i18n inventory check passed with `changed=false`.
- Focused Android tests passed.
- Stale reference search returned no matches.

## Evidence

- [ ] Failing test/log before + passing after
- [x] Trace/log snippets
- [ ] Screenshot/recording
- [ ] Perf numbers (if relevant)

```text
git diff --check: PASS
pnpm native:i18n:check: native-app-i18n: entries=2360 changed=false
Focused Android tests: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 50s
Stale reference search: no matches
```

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios:
  - Header New Chat controller path now uses `sessions.create`.
  - Gateway command discovery remains authoritative for Android slash suggestions.
  - Slash filtering still supports `/`, prefix matches such as `/mo`, and alias matches such as `/de`.
  - Description/category text does not create unrelated matches.
  - Native i18n inventory is synced after Android source changes.
- Edge cases checked:
  - Source-verified: no Android fallback command factory remains.
  - Source-verified: exact `/new` and `/reset` are not intercepted locally.
- What you did **not** verify:
  - Connected Android emulator/device visual flow.
  - Full Android unit suite.
  - APK build or install after the P1 patch.

## Review Conversations

- [ ] I replied to or resolved every bot review conversation I addressed in this PR.
- [x] I left unresolved only the conversations that still need reviewer or maintainer judgment.

No review conversation was resolved during this body-preparation phase.

## Compatibility / Migration

- Backward compatible? Yes. The Android UI remains a client of Gateway-advertised commands and the session API.
- Config/env changes? No.
- Migration needed? No.
- If yes, exact upgrade steps: None.

## Risks and Mitigations

- Risk: Connected Android visual behavior still needs device/emulator confirmation.
  - Mitigation: The PR body does not claim visual proof; it keeps the proof gap explicit.
- Risk: Empty Gateway command discovery now leaves Android with no slash suggestions.
  - Mitigation: This is intentional so Android does not advertise unsupported commands; command availability remains Gateway-owned.
- Risk: `sessions.create` semantics differ from the previous local reset behavior.
  - Mitigation: Focused tests assert the created session key is adopted and history/session state is refreshed after creation.
